metadata.title: Code, result records and manuscript sources for "Explainable Component-Fault Diagnostics and Maintenance-Priority Screening for Hydraulic-System Condition Monitoring"

creators.name: Imran
creators.affiliation: Interdisciplinary Research Center for Intelligent Manufacturing & Robotics, King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals, Dhahran, Saudi Arabia

metadata.description: Revised release accompanying the IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement manuscript. Contains the original pipeline (cycle-level features, multi-output random forest, grouped occlusion and permutation attributions, evidence graph, priority score, union bound, run-clustered bootstrap, degradation sweep, classifier comparators) and the analyses added in revision (run-aligned purged blocked split, condition-profile holdout, order-preservation checks of the bound, out-of-fold calibration, nested priority-weight selection, HistGradientBoosting ranking and attributions, attribution stability across folds and seeds, label-free example selection). Includes every result CSV behind a reported number, cached out-of-fold predictions, all figures, the LaTeX sources of the revised manuscript and a SHA-256 manifest. The raw UCI Condition Monitoring of Hydraulic Systems sensor streams are not redistributed; their digests are recorded in deposit/MANIFEST.csv.
